At the beginning of July, 1940, the Princess
Sumaire also calling herself Patiala, aged 23,
arrived in Shanghai from India and engaged a suite
at the Cathay Hotel. According to her own statement
she is the daughter of the late Maharajah of Patiala
and her mother is the daughter of Sir Sundar
Singh of Majitha (Revenue Minister of the Punjab
Legislative Assembly). Prior to the commencement
of the present European war, she was residing in
Paris with her mother. Immediately subsequent to
the declaration of war, her brother, the present
Maharajan of Patiala wrote to them instructing that
they should return without delay to Patiala. Owing
to sickness, her mother proceeded to Los Angeles while
she herself returned to Patiala. Some time later
she received a request from her mother to join her
in Los Angeles. With this intention, she left
Patiala for the U.S.A. but upon arrival in Shanghai,
she received a letter from her mother instructing her
to remain in Shanghai pending the receipt of further
information. After staying in the Cathay for some
weeks, she left for a holiday in Tsingtao returning
to Shanghai at the end of the summer where she is
now residing at the Park Hotel. The veracity of the
above statement is not guaranteed as the Princess
has a tendency towards inexactitude.

During her sojourn in Shanghai the activities
of the Princess have been and are open to suspicion

1940年7月初，苏迈尔公主（亦自称帕蒂亚拉），23岁，从印度抵达上海，并在华懋饭店（Cathay Hotel）租用了一套房间。据她本人陈述，她是已故帕蒂亚拉大君（Maharajah of Patiala）的女儿，其母亲是旁遮普立法议会财政部长马吉萨（Majitha）的桑达尔·辛格爵士（Sir Sundar Singh）的女儿。在目前这场欧洲战争爆发前，她与母亲居住在巴黎。宣战后立即，她的哥哥，即现任帕蒂亚拉大君写信给他们，指示他们立即返回帕蒂亚拉。由于生病，她的母亲前往洛杉矶，而她本人则返回了帕蒂亚拉。一段时间后，她收到母亲的请求，让她去洛杉矶与她汇合。怀着这个意图，她离开帕蒂亚拉前往美国，但抵达上海后，她收到母亲的一封信，指示她在收到进一步消息之前留在上海。在华懋饭店住了几周后，她去青岛度假，夏末回到上海，目前住在国际饭店（Park Hotel）。上述陈述的真实性无法保证，因为这位公主有不准确的倾向。

在她逗留上海期间，这位公主的活动一直且仍然令人怀疑

at 4p.m. on Oct. 8th, acting on instruction of
U.C.(Crime), the undersigned visited Dr. Tami,
Italian lawyer at 149 Yuen Ming Yuen Road.
Dr. Tami informed the undersigned that he
wished to lodge a complaint on behalf of Princess
Surair Singh of Patiala against an unknown person
or persons who sent her an anonymous letter
threatening to expose her conduct in the local
press and also hinting that her life may be in
danger if she would persist in associating herself
with fifth Columnists. Dr. Tami confidentially
informed the undersigned that Princess Surair Singh
is a British subject by birth and a wife of a
British subject. She is holder of a British passport
No. C.129231 issued to her on January 24, 1940 in
Paris, France. The passport is good for travelling
to India only as at the instructions of the Indian
Government all endorsements with exception of
India have been deleted and no further endorsement
is to be added without reference to the Government
of India. According to Dr. Tami, his client wishes
to obtain a divorce from her husband but owing to
the law and religion of her race she cannot obtain
the divorce and Dr. Tami is now trying to obtain
for her Chinese citizenship and thereby facilitate
the divorce proceedings which can be carried out in
the S.S.D. Court.
Dr. Tami handed over the threatening letter
to the undersigned but stated that he has no idea
who could write the same.
pages.zh:
1941年10月8日下午4点，根据刑事科上级官员（U.C.(Crime)）的指示，署名者走访了位于圆明园路149号的意大利律师塔米博士（Dr. Tami）。
塔米博士告知署名者，他希望代表帕蒂亚拉的苏赖尔·辛格公主（Princess Surair Singh）对一名或多名匿名信发送者提出投诉，该信件威胁要在当地报刊上揭露她的行为，并暗示如果她继续与第五纵队分子交往，她的生命可能会有危险。塔米博士私下告知署名者，苏赖尔·辛格公主生来就是英国臣民，并且是一名英国臣民的妻子。她持有1940年1月24日在法国巴黎签发的英国护照，号码为 C.129231。根据印度政府的指示，除印度外，所有签证背书均已被删除，未经印度政府同意不得添加任何新的背书，因此该护照仅适用于前往印度旅行。据塔米博士称，他的客户希望与丈夫离婚，但由于其种族的法律和宗教原因，她无法获得离婚，塔米博士现在正试图为她取得中国国籍，从而便利可以在特区法院（S.S.D. Court）进行的离婚诉讼。
塔米博士将恐吓信交给署名者，但表示他不知道是谁写的。

Translation

Shanghai, China.
October 3, 1941.

To
Her "Highness",
"Princess" of Patiala,
Park Hotel,
Shanghai.

Your "Highness",

We warn you : Your running around with
Fifth Columnists has completely discredited in the eyes
of the Public Opinion. It is generally known that you have
been relieved of your British passport and this fact together
with your present behaviour is only too convincing for everybody
that you could never be a Princess of Patiala but only a shrewd
coquette. It might be known to you that persons that become
too well known in China sometimes meet a surprisingly sudden
death.

We shall take the liberty of dispatching
a copy of this letter to the editor of "Shooting News" and
to other papers that might be interested in activities
like yours.

"Victory Organization"

SECRET
May 22, 1941.

Princess Sumair.

Princess Sumair is still in Shanghai
and at present is residing at 103 Great Western
Road, Hubertus Court (Fourth Floor).
There is no indication at the moment
of her intending to leave Shanghai.
According to information secured from a
certain reliable Consular source this lady is now
financially in a bad way which is confirmed to a
certain extent by the fact that she is rarely seen
in leading local night haunts and hotels which was
her previous wont.
Any further information of value that comes
to hand will be submitted immediately.

秘密
1941年5月22日。

苏迈尔公主。

苏迈尔公主仍在上海，目前居住在大西路103号 Hubertus Court（四楼）。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

Special Branch Station. File No.................... Date May 22, 1941

SUBJECT: Princess Sumair - Communication from Passport
Officer of H.B.M. Consulate-General, Shanghai.

Princess Sumair, details of whom appear on
the attached report dated November 23, 1940, is still
in Shanghai and at present is residing at 103
Great Western Road, Hubertus Court (Fourth Floor).
There is no indication at the moment of
her intending to leave Shanghai but arrangements
have been made whereby this office will be informed
prior to any departure she makes.
According to information secured from a
certain reliable consular source this lady is now
financially in a bad way which is confirmed to a
certain extent by the fact that she is rarely seen
in leading local night haunts and hotels which was
her previous wont.
Any further information of value that comes
to hand will be submitted immediately.

Ja. Pierce
D.S.I.

O. C. (Special Branch).

FILE

Further to the attached report, it
has been ascertained that the Princess Sumaire is
not the daughter of the late Maharajah of Patiala
but the daughter of his sister. She is the
grand-daughter of the Sirdar Umraha Singh, elder
brother of Sir Sundar Singh. In her early years,
she was married to Sirdar Ipjah Singh of the
Indian State Railways but was separated from him
several years ago. The present Maharajah and
the rest of her family have disowned her owing
to her loose morals. Although she was the niece
of the late Maharajah, she was probably his
mistress also. From an Indian source, it is
reported that she is a follower of the Lesbian
cult. She has unsuccessfully applied for visas
to Los Angeles and the West Indies. All
consulates have been warned regarding the character
of this female and it is possible that she will
remain in Shanghai indefinitely. The source
of her income is unknown, but it is quite possible
that she is engaged in highly paid prostitution.
At the moment, the political angle may be discarded,
but it is feasible that if her finances dwindle,
she may be used by some party in which case her
knowledge of India and her so-called rank may be
used to advantage. The other aspect is that she
may become a charge on H.B.M. Consulate-General.

继附呈报告之后，经查证，苏迈尔公主并非已故帕蒂亚拉大君（Maharajah of Patiala）之女，而是其姐妹之女。她是萨达尔·乌姆拉哈·辛格（Sirdar Umraha Singh）的孙女，萨达尔·乌姆拉哈·辛格系桑达尔·辛格爵士（Sir Sundar Singh）之兄。她早年嫁予印度国家铁路局的萨达尔·伊普贾赫·辛格（Sirdar Ipjah Singh），但数年前已与其分居。现任大君及其家族其他成员因其道德败坏而与她断绝关系。尽管她是已故大君的侄女，但很可能也是他的情妇。据一位印度消息来源称，她是女同性恋邪教的追随者。她申请前往洛杉矶和西印度群岛的签证均未成功。各领事馆均已收到关于此女性品行的警告，她可能会无限期地留在上海。其收入来源不明，但极有可能从事高收入的卖淫活动。目前，政治角度可以不予考虑，但若其财力枯竭，她可能会被某一方利用，届时她对印度的了解及其所谓的身份地位可能会被加以利用以谋取利益。另一方面是，她可能会成为英王陛下总领事馆的负担。
